data.name: Gibran
data.gender_notes: Gibran is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is powerful and generous. Derived from the Arabic root 'gb' which means power, strength, and 'r' which means generous and liberator. The name Gibran carries the meaning “Powerful, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Gibran usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who have a strong spiritual foundation and use their power and generosity to uplift others.
data.etymology: Gibran belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gibran total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: جبران
in_arabic.meaning: جبران تعني التوبة أو الرجوع إلى الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: جبران هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، ويعني التوبة أو الرجوع إلى الله. وهو مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ج-ب-ر' الذي يعني الإصلاح أو التكفير. وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47، حيث يقول الله تعالى: 'وَلَقَدْ جَاءَ أَهْلُ الْفِيلِ بِالْفِيلِ * أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَابِ الْفِيلِ * أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِي تَضْلِيلٍ * وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ * تَرْمِيهِمْ بِحِجَارَةٍ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ * فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَزَرْنِ مَأْكُولٍ'

in_urdu.name: جبران
in_urdu.meaning: جبران کا مطلب ہے توبہ یا اللہ کی طرف لوٹنا
in_urdu.long_meaning: جبران ایک مذکر نام ہے جس کی اصل عربی ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے توبہ کرنا یا اللہ کی طرف رجوع کرنا۔ یہ نام عربی جذر 'ج-ب-ر' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے اصلاح یا تکفیر۔ جبران نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعے کیا جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں۔

in_hindi.name: जिब्रान
in_hindi.meaning: जिब्रान का अर्थ है पश्चाताप या ईश्वर की ओर लौटना
in_hindi.long_meaning: जिब्रान एक पुल्लिंग नाम है जिसकी उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। इसका अर्थ है पश्चाताप करना या ईश्वर की ओर लौटना। यह नाम अरबी मूल 'ज-ब-र' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है सुधार या प्रायश्चित। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में जिब्रान नाम का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: جبراين
in_pashto.meaning: جبراين د توبې یا الله تعالی ته د رجوع معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: جبراين یو مذکر نوم دی چی د هغه اصل عربي دی. دے مطلب یی توبہ کول یا الله تعالی ته رجوع کول دي. دا نوم د عربي جذر 'ج-ب-ر' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چی د اصلاح یا تکفير معنی لري. په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتنو او نورو مسلمانانو لخوا کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Gibran
in_english.meaning: Gibran means repentance or return to God
in_english.long_meaning: Gibran is a masculine given name of Arabic origin. It means repentance or return to God. Derived from the Arabic root 'j-b-r', which signifies reformation or atonement. Gibran has been used across various Muslim cultures, including Arabic, Urdu, Turkish, and Persian-speaking communities. The name holds significant spiritual connotations, symbolizing a person's journey towards redemption and divine forgiveness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Gibran is not a common one in the Islamic world, but it is associated with notable figures who embody the essence of power and generosity. Gibran Kahlil Gibran, a Lebanese-American poet and artist, is perhaps the most well-known person bearing this name. His works, such as The Prophet and The Broken Wings, continue to inspire and impact Islamic and non-Islamic communities alike, emphasizing themes of love, self-realization, and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Gibran carries deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the idea of a powerful and generous spirit. It is a name that combines the traits of strength and generosity, reminding us of Allah's boundless generosity towards His creation. The name can serve as a reminder for an individual to strive for personal strength and to use that power to uplift and benefit others, emulating the characteristic traits of Allah.
